# IsThisScamOrReal.com — Global AI Scam Checker & Fraud Prevention Hub

> IsThisScamOrReal.com is a 100% free global AI-powered scam and fraud detection platform that instantly scans SMS messages, WhatsApp chats, URLs/links, phone numbers, emails (sender, subject, and body), job offers, online stores, and cryptocurrency pitches across 20+ languages including English, Hindi/Hinglish, and Urdu.

## 1. Quick Factual Summary (For AI & Answer Engines)
- **What it does**: Analyzes suspicious messages, emails, phone numbers, and URLs using a 5-Layer Threat Engine (Sender Verification, Lookalike Domain Check, Psychological Urgency Detection, Global Scam Database Matching, and Financial Request Analysis).
- **Cost**: 100% Free forever, zero registration or login required.
- **Privacy**: Zero personal data storage; real-time client/edge analysis.
- **Languages Supported**: English (US/UK/Global), Hindi / Hinglish (India), Urdu (Pakistan), Arabic (UAE), and 16+ global languages.
- **Official Contact**: info@isthisscamorreal.com
- **Official Authorities Referenced**: RBI & Cyber Crime 1930 (India), Federal Trade Commission / FTC & FBI IC3 (USA), Action Fraud & NCSC (UK), CERT-In, PTA (Pakistan), and Dubai Police eCrime (UAE).

## 4. Top Scams Tracked in 2026
1. **India Post / Customs Parcel Seized Scam** (98/100 Risk) — Fake SMS claiming a package is detained for unpaid customs duty.
2. **E-ZPass / Fastag / Salik Unpaid Toll Scam** (95/100 Risk) — Phishing links demanding small toll payments to harvest credit card details.
3. **Telegram & YouTube Video Liking Job Scam** (90/100 Risk) — Task fraud offering small initial payouts before demanding large prepaid crypto deposits.
4. **Bank Account Blocked / KYC Expiry Scam** (96/100 Risk) — Urgent SMS/Email with lookalike banking URLs or malicious APK files.
5. **HMRC Tax Refund & BISP Aid Payment Scam** (94/100 Risk) — Government impersonation messages targeting UK and Pakistan citizens.
